verdict.rationale: The only evidence of openness is community testimony: one user calls Better Auth "the best open-source option for a TypeScript developer" and another notes it's free, which suggests the source is publicly readable. No first-party documentation names a license or links to a source repository, and one user notes some features are enterprise-only. Missing for 10: first-party statement of the license (e.g., MIT), a documented public source repository link, and clarity on whether enterprise features are also source-available.
